there_he_is.speaker: Pat
lines: There he is. You sleep? Don't answer. Nobody slept.

eggs.speaker: Pat
lines: Powdered eggs again. I'm telling you, Tex — when this is over I am never again eating anything that arrives as a powder. Real eggs. A dozen. Fried in butter.

every_raid.speaker: Pat
lines: And every raid it gets more true.

butter.speaker: Pat
lines: Then I'll marry a dairy farmer's daughter. Sister Immaculata always said: aim practical, Pasquale.

medal.speaker: Pat
lines: Twice this morning. Once for the takeoff, once for the getting back. Forty-one missions this medal's flown and counting. It works, Tex.

book.speaker: Pat
lines: You and that pamphlet again. Paine. The man's been dead a hundred years — what's he know about a B-17?

choices.text: 'The harder the conflict, the more glorious the triumph.' He knew plenty.
It's something to hold. Same as your medal.

quote.speaker: Pat
lines: See, this is why the fellas think you're strange. Quoting ghosts before breakfast.

same_church.speaker: Pat
lines: ...Yeah. All right, Professor. Same church, different pew.

captain_call.speaker: Captain
lines: Boyd! Costa! Saddle up — engines in ten.

other_side.speaker: Pat
lines: That's us. See you on the other side, Tex.
